question: Can I cycle Esper Sojourners even if there are no targets for its cycling trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the cycling ability itself has no targets, so you can cycle it anyway.
expected.answer: You can cycle this card even if there are no targets for the triggered ability. That's because the cycling ability itself has no targets.
